dialogues.jp:
暦先生の声に、クラスの者たちが一斉に反応し
てプリントを捲る。
dialogues.en:
At Koyomi-sensei's signal, the class flipped over their exam
sheets at once.
dialogues.text:
At Koyomi-sensei's signal, the class flipped over their exam
sheets at once.

dialogues.jp: （いよいよ、最強の敵の登場だ……）
dialogues.en: "(So, the most fearsome enemy has shown it's face...)"
dialogues.text: "(So, the most fearsome enemy has shown it's face...)"

dialogues.jp: 英語の問題用紙を前に、ごくりと唾を飲み込む。
dialogues.en:
Looking at the english question sheet in front of me, I
gulped my saliva down hard.
dialogues.text:
Looking at the english question sheet in front of me, I
gulped my saliva down hard.

dialogues.jp:
（まずは覚えているうちに、単語の方を片付け
　ないとな）
dialogues.en:
"(I don't remember much, I doubt I can do the vocabulary
questions...)"
dialogues.text:
"(I don't remember much, I doubt I can do the vocabulary
questions...)"

dialogues.jp: 問題用紙を見渡し、単語問題を埋めていく。
dialogues.en:
I leave the vocabulary questions blank and move on to the
rest of the paper.
dialogues.text:
I leave the vocabulary questions blank and move on to the
rest of the paper.

dialogues.jp:
本日最後の敵は英語だった。忘れる前に単語を
埋めて、他の問題へと移っていく……。
dialogues.en:
Today's most fearsome enemy was english. I forgot most of
what I studied about the vocabulary questions, so I quickly
moved on to the other ones...
dialogues.text:
Today's most fearsome enemy was english. I forgot most of
what I studied about the vocabulary questions, so I quickly
moved on to the other ones...
